primary_arabic_matn_excerpt: بُنِيَ الإِسْلاَمُ عَلَى خَمْسٍ شَهَادَةِ أَنْ لاَ إِلَهَ إِلاَّ اللَّهُ وَأَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ وَإِقَامِ الصَّلاَةِ وَإِيتَاءِ الزَّكَاةِ وَحَجِّ الْبَيْتِ وَصَوْمِ رَمَضَانَ

review_finding: This primary five-support report includes both the monotheism testimony and Muhammad as servant and Messenger, with pilgrimage before Ramadan. Deen Muslim85 mentions testimony to Allah's oneness but omits the explicit Muhammad clause found in this witness. The source wording remains unchanged and is treated as a condensed/variant parallel, without completing the omitted clause.
